NORTH PIER TECHNICAL LIBRARY
ARCHIVE DESK REQUEST / ITEM 013

A recovered workstation index references the Python 1.5 library documentation.

The printed reference is:

    http://www.python.org/1.5/

The library copy has no reliable publication date. The archive desk has asked for the earliest successful capture of this exact page in the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine.

Do not substitute:
- the first capture of the python.org homepage;
- the first capture of the entire python.org domain;
- a redirect-only response.

The requested result is the earliest successful HTML page capture for the exact URL above.
